name: vartest_extras
expr: [h95, p95, c95] = vartest(x, 1, 'Alpha', 0.05); [h99, p99, c99] = vartest(x, 1, 'Alpha', 0.01); [h_r, p_r, c_r] = vartest(x, 1, 'Tail', 'right'); [h2, p2, c2] = vartest2(x, y, 'Alpha', 0.01); [h2t, p2t] = vartest2(x, y, 'Tail', 'right');
comment: Sig: vartest(x, v[, NV]) and vartest2(x, y[, NV]). Both adapters now parse Alpha and Tail Name-Value pairs (case-insensitive). 'Dim' N-V throws (parity gap). 4th output remains scalar T/F (struct deferred). Closes audit/findings/stats/{vartest,vartest2}.md (partial).
